intentional_differences.purpose: Inherited floating push workflow removed after dedicated vNext Linux, Windows, and macOS baseline workflows replaced all of its jobs.
Ubuntu 24.04 GCC 13 and Clang 18 full-build, install, upstream-test, and retained-evidence CI gates.
macOS 15 arm64 and Intel Xcode 16 full-build, install, upstream-test, and retained-evidence CI gates on the approved cadences.
Windows Server 2022 MSVC v143 full-build, install, upstream-test, and retained-evidence CI gate.
OpenMW Debian dependency groups with the approved Linux compiler majors and Ninja named explicitly.
Versioned cross-platform configure and build presets for the Phase 1 OpenMW baseline test path.
Machine-readable OpenMW baseline, cutover, dependency-input, and intentional-difference record.
Living vNext phase, gate, status, and verification tracker.
Reference-only inventory of archived TES3MP gameplay behavior.
Documented local configure, build, test, provisioning, and evidence procedure for the pinned baseline.
Recorded pre-cutover repository and archive provenance.
Accepted vNext product direction and architecture boundaries.
Owner-approved exact-tree baseline-cutover mechanics.
Owner-approved platform, CI, toolchain, and dependency policy.
Fail-closed Ubuntu runner, compiler, package, repository, and package-license evidence capture.
Fail-closed macOS runner, Xcode/AppleClang, Homebrew, vcpkg, Qt, package, and license evidence capture.
Fail-closed Windows runner, MSVC toolchain, dependency-manifest, package, and license evidence capture.
Cross-platform local baseline configure, build, upstream-test, and evidence runner.
Unit and workflow-policy tests for the Linux baseline evidence gate.
Unit and workflow-policy tests for the macOS baseline evidence gate.
Unit and workflow-policy tests for the Windows baseline evidence gate.
Unit tests for local baseline runner validation and dependency-lock handling.
Failure-case tests for the machine-checkable provenance contract.
Cross-platform verifier that fails on unrecorded tree or dependency-input drift.
Pinned Windows and macOS baseline dependency manifests, archives, Qt inputs, and acquisition-tool identities.

dependency_inputs.resolution: OpenMW 0.51 CMake declarations pin fetched source tags or commits and integrity hashes; the vNext presets and runner define the shared local test build while system package alternatives remain platform-selected.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Fetched projects supply their own license files; system-package and bundle license inventories must be retained with the resolved environment artifacts in Slices 1.4-1.7.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.4 captures local resolved-tool and dependency evidence; Slices 1.5-1.7 retain the corresponding CI environment and license artifacts for every supported platform.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The workflow pins Ubuntu 24.04, the GCC 13 and Clang 18 compiler families, Ninja, and exact checkout/upload action commits. Ubuntu and PPA package versions remain runner-resolved and are captured with the runner image and apt source metadata on every run.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Each Linux compiler job archives the complete dpkg name/version/architecture inventory and dereferenced /usr/share/doc package copyright set with SHA-256 identities.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.5 remains In Progress until both committed GitHub Actions compiler jobs pass and their retained evidence artifacts are reviewed.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The dedicated workflow pins macOS 15 runner families and exact checkout/upload action commits. The repository lock pins the OpenMW dependency repository commit, both manifest SHA-256 identities, bundle URLs and SHA-512 identities, and named Homebrew formulas. Homebrew package versions remain runner-resolved and are captured without an implicit update on every run.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Each macOS architecture job archives the pinned manifest and lock, all vcpkg package lists and retained licenses, resolved Homebrew formula versions and declared licenses, the exact Qt version and official license reference, runner/Xcode/AppleClang metadata, and the installed tree.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.7 remains In Progress until the committed arm64 per-change job and a manually dispatched Intel job pass and both retained evidence artifacts are reviewed.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The shared lock records commit-pinned OpenMW manifests, manifest SHA-256 identities, dependency archive URLs and SHA-512 identities, the exact Windows Qt/aqt inputs, and the named macOS Homebrew formulas for every supported bundle-based platform path.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Platform evidence capture archives this exact lock beside resolved vcpkg package/license inventories and the applicable Qt license record.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slices 1.6 and 1.7 retain the lock and prove every selected architecture bundle on its supported hosted runner.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The dedicated workflow pins Windows Server 2022 and exact checkout, MSVC environment, and artifact action commits. The repository lock pins the OpenMW dependency repository commit and manifest SHA-256, bundle URL and SHA-512, Qt 6.6.3 target, and aqtinstall v3.1.15 SHA-256.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: The Windows job archives the pinned dependency manifest and lock, all vcpkg package lists and retained copyright/license files, the exact Qt version/target with its official license reference, exact runner/toolchain metadata, and the installed tree.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.6 remains In Progress until the committed Windows Server 2022/MSVC v143 job passes and its retained evidence artifact is reviewed.
